name: testimonial-marquee
title: Testimonial Marquee
description: Rows of testimonial cards drifting in opposite directions with faded edges. Built on Marquee; still under reduced motion.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; quote: string; name: string; role?: string; company?: string }[]
props.description: Testimonials, dealt out to the rows in turn.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of rows. Each row runs against the one above.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full loop of a row.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause a row while the pointer or focus is on it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops every row and shows the cards still.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
